sources.title: Chengdu People's Park Guide 2026: Things to Do, Tea Culture & Tips
sources.content:
Established in 1911, Chengdu People's Park is the oldest public park in Sichuan and the first urban park in the city. The venue operates around the clock, with evening illumination from 6:30 PM to 10:00 PM (October-April) or 8:00 PM to 10:30 PM (May-September). Entry is completely free.

Primary Attractions:

Heming Teahouse stands as the park's signature experience. Operating since 1923, this establishment offers traditional gaiwan tea starting at 16 CNY, with average pricing between 20-30 CNY. The venue features Sichuan Opera performances, including the famous face-changing act, for 48 CNY per person.

Monument to Railway Protection Movement honors those who died during Sichuan's 1911 uprising. Built in 1913, it represents the beginning of the Xinhai Revolution and symbolized Sichuan people's sacrifice in defense of national sovereignty.

Matchmaking Corner provides an intriguing cultural experience, particularly on weekends. Parents display résumés on colored paper—pink for women, blue for men—listing details like age, profession, and income.

Shaocheng Garden showcases classical Western Sichuan landscaping with artificial hills, pavilions, and creeks. Ear-cleaning services offer traditional relaxation treatments.

Air-Raid Shelter No. 1 maintains consistent 25°C temperatures year-round, serving as both historical memorial and summer refuge.

Practical Information:
Location: No. 8 Xiaonan Street, Qingyang District
Transportation: Metro Line 2 (People's Park Station, Exit B)
Nearby Food: Zhong Dumplings location features signature chili oil dumplings at 37 CNY per person
Accessibility: The walkways are smooth and accessible. Tea stands and other areas are well-designed for visitors with strollers or wheelchairs.

sources.title: People's Park - Sichuan Travel Guide
sources.content:
People's Park stands as the first park in Chengdu and one of the first established parks in China. Originally named Shaocheng Park when constructed in 1911, it serves as a window into local Chengdu lifestyle and culture.

Location & Access: The park sits centrally near Tianfu Square with multiple transit options including bus routes 4, 30, 42, 62, 53, 80 and subway line 2. Admission is complimentary with four convenient entrances.

Main Attractions:

Tea Houses: Multiple tea gardens operate within the park, with Heming Tea House being the most prominent. Visitors observe residents conducting business meetings, playing mahjong, and socializing—reflecting the city's relaxed character. The park also offers ear-cleaning services, a traditional Chengdu specialty involving metal sticks and cotton swabs for ear hygiene.

Match-Making Corner: Near the south entrance, a dedicated section features match-making leaflets hung on strings. Parents seeking marriage partners for their children visit match-makers daily from 9am to 5pm, reviewing information about candidates including income and property ownership.

Dancing Groups: Beginning around 9:00am, retired residents engage in various dance styles—from traditional fan-dancing to modern waltz—in designated park spaces.

Bonsai Garden: A modest garden near the south entrance showcases various bonsai specimens.

Republic Revolution Monument: This commemorates casualties from the 1911 Protecting the Right of Building Railway movement.

Visiting Tips:
- Hours: 6:00am-10:00pm
- Duration: 2 hours recommended
- Best time: Year-round; mornings offer quieter experiences

sources.title: Chengdu's ancient teahouses are going viral - National Geographic
sources.content:
Chengdu's teahouse culture centered around People's Park has become a viral phenomenon. The Heming Teahouse, arguably one of the most famous teahouses in Chengdu, is located in the heart of People's Park and has a history that spans over a hundred years.

The tea garden is packed with people sipping tea in between naps, while reading a novel, having a good old natter and a laugh with friends or playing a lively game of mah-jong. Folk order zhuyeqing, bitan piaoxue, longjing, chrysanthemum or tieguanyin. Teas are cheap and come with a massive flask of boiling water for top-ups; you can literally extend your tea for hours without obligation to spend on anything else.

Don't just go for the fanciest-looking tea house. Sometimes the more modest ones offer the most authentic experience.

sources.title: 成都人民公园 - 百度百科
sources.content:
成都人民公园位于成都市青羊区少城路12号，占地112639平方米。这是一座综合性公园，集园林、文化、文物保护、爱国主义教育、休闲娱乐于一体。

历史背景：公园始建于1911年，原名少城公园。将军玉昆与四川省劝业道道台周善培主持修建，打算在祠堂街修建公园，开放满城。民国时期，为纪念保路运动，修建了辛亥秋保路死事纪念碑（全国重点文物保护单位）。

建国后发展：1949年12月10日成都解放后，少城公园获得新生，次年更名为人民公园。1951年贺龙元帅亲临公园视察并提出重要指示。

主要景点：
金水溪：总长355米，宽6米，河底由光滑小卵石铺成。
辛亥广场：面积3000平方米，制作了反映四川辛亥保路革命斗争历史的地面平浮雕。
金鱼岛：位于人工湖中，恢复了永聚历史老茶社。
兰草园：为成都市市区公园中最大的兰草风景花园。
盆景园：常年展出盆景200余盆。
人工湖：面积约20亩，为夏季休闲避暑、荡舟娱乐之地。

文化设施：公园内设有四川保路运动史事陈列馆，保留鹤鸣茶社等百年老字号茶馆，以及枕流茶园等文化休闲场所。

访问信息：等级AAAA级旅游景区。门票平时免费，花展期间12元/人。开放时间冬季6:30-22:00，夏季6:00-22:30。可乘多条公交线路到达。

特色活动：公园每年举办秋季菊花展和消夏荷花展，吸引全国参展单位和众多游客。

sources.title: Travelogue: Heming Tea House - 100 years of tea by the lake
sources.content:
Heming Teahouse in Chengdu's People's Park is one of the oldest and most iconic teahouses in the city. Strolling in the park, you will see local people drinking tea, playing mahjong or cards, dancing, singing, and playing music.

People start to dance in different groups after 9:00 o'clock. Before that there are some people doing Taichi when it is still quiet. Visitors are usually welcome to join the dancers anytime.

There are some people providing ear-cleaning service in the park. The ear-cleaning or ear-picking service is unique in Chengdu.

Especially at weekends, hundreds of bamboo chairs will be occupied by tea-drinkers in the Heming Teahouse.

sources.title: People's Park in Chengdu: where real local life happens - Baba Goes China
sources.content:
People's Park in Chengdu: where real local life happens. Everything you need to know to plan your visit in Chengdu's most famous park. By Magda Sawyer, November 2024.

Practical Information:
Location: No.12 Shaocheng Road, Citang Street, Qingyang District, Chengdu
Opening Hours: Park: Daily 6:00-10:30 PM (summer); 6:30-10:00 (winter). Tea Houses: Usually until 7:00 PM. Amusement Park rides: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM.
Cost: Park entrance: Free. Tea houses: 15-100¥ depending on location and if includes performance. Amusement rides: Additional cost.
Getting There: Take Metro Line 2 to People's Park station, Exit A or C.

More Than Just Another City Park: The article describes the park as Chengdu's living room, where local life just happens. It emphasizes traditional tea houses, opera performances, and authentic Chinese cultural experiences unavailable in typical guidebooks.

The author notes visiting twice during their Chengdu stay, wishing they had time for more visits. The piece highlights the park's ability to showcase everything making Chengdu special through its relaxed atmosphere, the food culture, and the perfect blend of tradition and modern life.

What to Do:
Tea House Experience: Prices vary significantly. Some offer Sichuan opera performances including face-changing acts. Tea tickets often include shows—described as great value. Close around 7 PM. Pro tip: Don't just go for the fanciest-looking tea house. Sometimes the more modest ones offer the most authentic experience.

For the Kids: Small amusement park suitable for younger children. Plenty of running space. Shaded paths providing comfort during summer heat.

Food Scene: Various street food vendors throughout. Traditional Sichuan specialties.

Best Time to Visit: The park is particularly delightful for escaping Chengdu's notorious summer heat and humidity. Ancient trees provide shade and quiet rest spots.

The authors conclude that People's Park was a trip highlight, representing a rare blend where tourist attractions and local life blend perfectly.
